_design.name: ohyeah-achacha-logo-v1
_design.channel: オーイェーのアチャチャチャンネル
_design.intended_use: Channel logo generation for OhYeahAchacha YouTube channel

model_recommendation.notes: Use any SDXL checkpoint optimised for flat illustration or vector-like output (e.g. CounterfeitXL, AnythingXL).

design_intent.text_layout: オーイェーの (small, top) + アチャチャチャンネル (large, main)
design_intent.font_style: quirky-cute — between kitschy/retro and kawaii (e.g. RocknRoll One, Rampart One, 851手書き雑フォント)
design_intent.note: SD/SDXL cannot reliably render Japanese text. Generate decorative elements in ComfyUI, then overlay Japanese text with a design tool (Canva, Figma, etc.).

color_variants.full_color: vibrant yellow orange red palette, saturated colors
color_variants.white_on_dark: white fill, dark thick outline, high contrast

adjustment_guide.more_pop: Add pop art, halftone dots, bold comic style and raise cfg to 7.5.
adjustment_guide.more_outline: Append thick black outline, stroke border, outlined art style to positive prompt.
adjustment_guide.more_transparent: Post-process with background removal (rembg or similar) if alpha output is unavailable.

inputs.text: masterpiece, best quality, channel logo emblem, quirky cute pop style, bold thick outlines, vibrant warm colors, high contrast, transparent background, clean vector-like illustration, flat shading, cheerful energetic mood, playful retro kawaii aesthetic, decorative frame, no text, no background, cutout style, bright saturated palette, yellow orange accent colors

photorealistic, realistic texture, 3d render, text, letters, watermark, signature, busy background, gradient background, white background, black background, cluttered composition, muted colors, low contrast, blur, noise
